decisions.reason: The FAQ already states that referred primary mints award Small Block tickets and no-referral mints allocate tickets randomly; it does not state that secondary sales generate new tickets.
The source changes ticket issuance and accounting semantics, not the valid or invalid referral-code feedback text.
The candidate already requires random allocation of a ticket when no referral code is used, and its same-message RESUME restores that established rule after the prior ambiguity.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires displayed totals to include one ticket per primary mint, including random no-referral allocations, while excluding secondary sales.
The source governs ticket generation and reconciliation; it does not change the Small Block draw amount, winner count, or the sales-based draw trigger, which may still count secondary sales.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires commission totals to include randomly allocated no-referral commissions for primary mints and to exclude secondary sales.
The source reports registration and accounting of randomly issued tickets but does not identify NFT metadata or change any metadata attribute.
Random allocation of no-referral commissions is already required; the source concerns missing registration and does not resolve the separate first-mint recipient ambiguity.
The existing state already allocates a $5 commission per primary mint, and the source does not change the mint price, allocation amounts, or prize-pool split.
The direct-referral commission remains a $5 payment triggered by use of a valid referral code; randomly allocated no-referral commissions are owned by a separate Requirement.
The source changes which primary mints generate tickets but does not change the prize-winner selection method, eligible active-ticket population, or Chainlink VRF behavior.
The current About-page copy already says completed referrals generate tickets and no-code mints allocate a ticket randomly, without claiming that secondary sales generate new tickets.
